docs/BUSINESS_CASE.md 'What would have to change to NOT reach $100K' -> 'Annual mix stays at 0%' -- the shippable-TODAY figure, on the CONSERVATIVE store channel. RE-PRICED 2026-07-28 from $99,926: that reading was ~$74 below the floor purely because it applied a 30% commission this business pays on neither channel at this scale. Now clears the floor on the store channel at $121,339 and on web/Stripe at $136,762 (business_case_web_channel_arr). Tight tolerance: the figure under active auditor scrutiny.

docs/BUSINESS_CASE.md 'What would have to change to NOT reach $100K' -> 'Monthly Pro churn rises from 7% to 12%' -- RE-PRICED 2026-07-28 from $93,556 by the take-rate correction. This downside now clears the floor; before the correction it did not.
docs/BUSINESS_CASE.md 'What would have to change to NOT reach $100K' -> 'Annual renewal churn rises to 40%' -- RE-PRICED 2026-07-28 from $103,214 by the take-rate correction.

docs/BUSINESS_CASE.md 'Channel economics' -- the WEB/Stripe reading of the shippable-TODAY case (Scenario B inputs, annual gated off), priced at Stripe's published 2.9% + $0.30 (+0.7% Billing on recurring) instead of a store commission. Registered 2026-07-28 alongside the store reading so BOTH ends of the channel band are mechanically verified, not just the one that is quoted.

docs/BUSINESS_CASE.md 'Channel economics' / 'Annual mix stays at 0%' -- the YEAR-1 EXIT run-rate (not steady-state) for the shippable-TODAY case on the store channel. Added 2026-08-03 per the GTM Auditor's business_case_honesty finding that $121,339/$136,762 were quoted 'over the floor' with no year-1 caveat despite using the identical multi-year pool-fill formula as the $149.3K base case (which does carry one). $73,519 is BELOW the $100K floor.

docs/BUSINESS_CASE.md 'Channel economics' -- the YEAR-1 EXIT run-rate for the shippable-TODAY case on the WEB/Stripe channel, paired with business_case_without_annual_year1_arr's store reading. Added 2026-08-03, same rationale.

docs/BUSINESS_CASE.md Scenario B 'Steady-state, not year-1' box -- replaces the previously-uncomputed prose range ('~$70-73K') with an exact, reproducible year-1 exit run-rate. Added 2026-08-03 for FACTORY_STANDARD S22 (computed, not eyeballed).
